text.original: Learn about Harborview Property Management, a Seattle-based rental management company serving property owners and tenants since 2015.
Property management that works for both sides of the lease

Harborview Property Management was founded in 2015 by Dana Whitfield, a longtime Seattle leasing agent who kept watching owners get burned by unresponsive management companies and tenants get stuck waiting weeks for repairs. She started Harborview with a simple premise: property management should work well for both sides of the lease.

Eleven years later, Harborview manages more than 410 rental units across Seattle, the Eastside, and surrounding neighborhoods — everything from single-family homes to small multifamily buildings. Our team of licensed property managers, leasing specialists, and maintenance coordinators handles the daily work of ownership, from marketing vacancies to answering a 2am pipe leak.

We're still locally owned and Seattle-based, with every property manager living in the neighborhoods we serve. Owners get a partner who treats their investment like it matters; tenants get a management company that actually returns their calls.
Maintenance requests get a response within hours, not days — for every tenant, on every property we manage.
Owners see every dollar in and out through a live portal, with no surprise fees buried in the fine print.
Our team lives and works in the neighborhoods we manage, from Ballard to Bellevue, and prices accordingly.
We measure success by owner retention and tenant renewal rates, not just how fast we can fill a vacancy.

What is Harborview's property management fee?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: Our standard management fee is 8% of collected monthly rent, with no charge for vacant units. Leasing a new tenant carries a one-time fee equal to 50% of one month's rent — we'll walk through full pricing during your property assessment.
Is there a fee to apply for a rental?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: Yes, each adult applicant pays a $45 non-refundable application fee, which covers the cost of credit, background, and rental-history screening.

text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: Every applicant undergoes a credit check, nationwide criminal background check, eviction history search, and verification of income and rental references before approval.
How long does the rental application process take?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: Most applications are reviewed within 1-2 business days once we've received all required documents and verified income and references.
Do you handle maintenance emergencies after hours?
text.notes: Preserves the trailing +/− toggle icon — only the question text itself is replaced.

text.original: Yes — our maintenance line is staffed 24/7. Emergency issues like flooding, no heat, or lockouts are dispatched to a vendor the same day, any day of the week.

This sunlit two-bedroom unit occupies the ground floor of a beautifully maintained 1920s craftsman fourplex in the heart of Fremont, just blocks from the Ship Canal, the Fremont Bridge, and the neighborhood's cafes and breweries. Original hardwood floors and tall windows pair with an updated kitchen and in-unit laundry. Harborview handles all maintenance and leasing for this property, with online rent payment and a dedicated 24/7 maintenance line available to every tenant from day one.
